get.summary: Redirect URI of the identity provider
get.description: Always answers with a redirect to the SPA (`/auth/callback`). Success: `?status=success` and the refresh cookie is set; the SPA then calls POST /auth/refresh. Failure: `?status=error&code=<code>` with no session. Codes: ACCESS_DENIED, AUTH_FAILED, EMAIL_MISSING, EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED, ACCOUNT_PENDING_ACTIVATION, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, ACCOUNT_DISABLED, NO_ACTIVE_ROLE, ROLES_UNAVAILABLE, INVITATION_INVALID, INVITATION_MISMATCH. Activation (AA07): `?status=activated` and no session.

post.summary: Start the activation of an external account (AA07): redirects to its provider
post.description: Form POST from the activation page (browser navigation, `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), so the token never goes in a URL. The provider is the one linked to the invited account. The transaction cookie is marked as an activation: the callback then only activates the account if the authenticated identity is the one linked to it, and never opens a session. Any failure redirects to the SPA (`/auth/callback?status=error&code=INVITATION_INVALID` or `AUTH_FAILED`).

303.description: Redirect to the identity provider, or to the SPA with an error code

Set-Cookie.description: lp_oidc transaction cookie, only when going to the provider

pendingActivation.description: Inactive account that was never activated (it needs its invitation).

quantity.description: Non-negative integer representing the abstract stock units.

content.description: JSON object defining kitchen dimensions and elements.

KitchenAssemblyLinePlacement.description: Optional. Places an assembly line configuration in the kitchen (VIS03), as a back-end reference resolved by id (WEB06).

type.description: VIS03 components: counter, receiving-platform, crust-dispenser (overhead crust supply), conveyor-belt, robotic-arm, wood-fired-oven. The generic types are kept for compatibility.

model.description: Optional (kitchen decoration/tool elements). Procedural kitchen furniture built at the size given by scale (metres), standing on y = 0 with its front towards +z.

modelReference.description: Optional imported 3D model: absolute http(s) URL or root-relative path (ADR-0021). Protocol-relative (//) and other schemes are rejected. When absent, the element is created procedurally from its type (VIS03).

Material.description: Textures and material properties of a 3D object (VIS04). Texture maps are absolute http(s) URLs or root-relative paths (ADR-0021). A textured material needs a colorMap and at least one of roughnessMap, bumpMap or normalMap.

repeat.description: How many times the textures repeat across the surface.

AssemblyLineConfigurationContent.description: Line definition in its own local coordinate system (origin at the line origin). dimensions is the footprint of the line; element transforms are relative to the line origin.

simulated.description: Always true: offers are manual or LLM-prepared.
